messages.text:
You'd get back BRL 24.90 for the ceramic plant pot. That is what you paid for that unit, after its share of the discount (refund-policy/v2/amount). The shop's records show the pot as received back (refund-policy/v2/return).

The refund is paid only to your original payment, and your order has a single valid payment record (refund-policy/v2/payment). Nothing is automatic yet. Two steps come first (refund-policy/v2/approval):
1. You confirm the proposal with the button on the proposal card. Typing "yes" in the chat doesn't confirm it.
2. A staff member approves it.

After that, I'll give you the receipt number. The receipt records the refund in the shop's test ledger. It isn't a bank transfer, and the shop gives no date for when money appears (refund-policy/v2/payout).
